page.title: Storage
page.subtitle: Where your sorted cards are kept, box by box, in the order they went in.
page.emptyDescription: When you empty a bin from the scanner's Bin Levels, or when a full bin pauses scanning, pick or create a location to record where its cards went.
page.deleteDescription: The cards stay in your collections, but they lose this location and their position in it.

emptyDialog.title: Empty bin {{bin}}
emptyDialog.description: Pick where you're putting this bin's cards. Each card is recorded there in the order it was scanned, so you can find it later.
emptyDialog.allFullDescription: Every bin is full, so scanning is paused. Take the cards out of bin {{bin}} and pick where they're going. Each card is recorded there in the order it was scanned.
emptyDialog.lockedDescription: This resets bin {{bin}}'s fill counter to zero. Make sure you've taken the cards out first.

cards.emptyDescription: Cards show up here once a bin is emptied into this location.
cards.noMatchesDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.

toasts.cardRemovedFromCollection: Card removed from its location and collection

removeDialog.title: Remove {{name}} from {{location}}?
removeDialog.description: Use this when you've taken the card out of the box. Its position in the box is left empty.
removeDialog.choiceDescription: Remove it from the location only if you moved it, for example into a deck. Remove it from {{collection}} too if it's gone for good, for example because you sold it. Its position in the box is left empty either way.

search.limited: Showing the first {{count}} cards. Search for more of the name to narrow it down.

upgrade.businessOnly: Storage locations are not part of your plan.
upgrade.locked: Record which box every card goes into, and where in it, when you empty a bin.
upgrade.lockedWithLocations: You can still view, search and export your locations and the cards in them. Changing anything needs a plan that includes storage.

review.nothingLeft: Nothing left to review. Every card here has already been reviewed.
review.startTitle: Go through the cards in this location that haven't been reviewed yet, in box order

emptyAllDialog.title: Empty all bins
emptyAllDialog.description_one: Mark every bin as emptied. Pick where the {{count}} card went so you can find it later.
emptyAllDialog.description_other: Mark every bin as emptied. Pick where the {{count}} cards went so you can find them later.
emptyAllDialog.perBin: Choose a location for each bin

moveDialog.description_one: The card is added to the end of the location you pick. If it was stored somewhere else, it leaves that location.
moveDialog.description_other: The cards are added to the end of the location you pick, in the order you selected them. Cards stored somewhere else leave their old location.
moveDialog.collectionDescription_one: The card leaves this collection and joins the one you pick. It keeps its storage location and leaves its bin.
moveDialog.collectionDescription_other: The cards leave this collection and join the one you pick. They keep their storage locations and leave their bins.

pickList.title: Pick list
pickList.description: Paste a decklist to see where each card is stored, then tick cards off as you pull them.
pickList.decklistHint: One card per line. Quantities, set codes and section headers are fine.
pickList.emptyTitle: None of these cards are stored
pickList.emptyDescription: Only cards in a storage location show up on a pick list.
pickList.loadFailed: The pick list couldn't be loaded.
pickList.finishTitle_one: Remove {{count}} picked card from its location?
pickList.finishTitle_other: Remove {{count}} picked cards from their locations?
pickList.finishDescription: They stay in your collection. The pick list is cleared afterwards.

scan.noMatch: No card recognized. Try again with the whole card in view.
scan.notOnList: {{name}} isn't left on your pick list.
scan.hint: Hold one card in front of the camera and press Scan card.
scan.cameraFailed: The camera couldn't be started. Check that this browser is allowed to use it.
scan.alreadyPicked: Every copy of {{name}} on your pick list is already picked.

verify.description: Scan the cards in this location to check everything that should be here is.
verify.emptyDescription: This location has no cards stored in it yet.
verify.loadFailed: This location's cards couldn't be loaded.
verify.truncated: Only the first {{max}} cards in this location can be verified.
verify.complete: Every card in this location is verified.
verify.notInLocationDescription: These cards aren't recorded in this location. Put them where they belong, or move them here.

scan.alreadyVerified: Every copy of {{name}} in this location is already verified.
scan.hint: Hold one card from this location in front of the camera and press Scan card.
